artifacts.summary: Research on extending phase-count corroboration to the handoff-present completion path: confirms the asymmetry, evaluates options A/B/C, flags an unnamed constraint-text edit requirement in both orchestrator SKILL.md files, and flags a scratch-deploy-tree verification hazard.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's orchestration system, .claude/scripts/skill-base.sh's skill_write_orchestrator_handoff() has ZERO live callers despite being documented as the canonical handoff writer. Every live .orchestrator-handoff.json write is instead free-text JSON composed by an LLM agent (general-implementation-hard-agent.md's H9 Stage 5) following a worked example in its own prose contract, not a validated helper call. Before assuming a 'helper vs raw jq-n' dichotomy exists for handoff writers, verify actual callers via grep -- the dichotomy the docs imply does not exist today.

scripts/validate-handoff.sh in this repo already implements a correct required-field-null-check for .orchestrator-handoff.json (phases_completed/phases_total/status/blockers) but is never invoked in any live orchestration path (only cited as prose precedent in handoff-schema.md and orchestrate-triage-classify.sh comments). It is a ready-made, unwired producer-side validator for future handoff-integrity work.

skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's '## MUST NOT (Context Flatness Constraint)' section and skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md's 'Tool Constraints > Read allowlist' section both contain explicit prose asserting that plan-file corroboration reads are scoped ONLY to the missing/stale-handoff branch of Stage 5. Any future work that widens a plan-file read to a new branch (e.g. the handoff-present branch) must edit these prose passages in the same change, or the new code silently contradicts a stated architectural invariant that nothing else checks mechanically.
